record.question: Medical Record Management defined Medical Records as:
options: Medical Record as a clinical, scientific, administrative and medico legal document
The medical record is who, what, where, when and how of patient care
record.explanation: Answer A: Medical Record as a clinical, scientific, administrative and medico legal document. A medical record is a clinical and administrative document that records a patient’s care and may also have scientific/statistical and legal value. Source/context note: The source presents a broad definition; other authorities use slightly different definitions. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
